name: Product hero
description: The open product's photo, name, description and price.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/product-hero", name: "Product hero", kind: Kind.productCard,
  description: "The open product's photo, name, description and price.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Image(src: options.product.image_url, alt: options.product.name, aspectRatio: 1.33, fit: Fit.cover, radius: Radius.lg),
      Text(child: options.product.name, size: FontSize.xl, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      If(condition: options.product.description, then: Text(child: options.product.description, color: Color.textMuted, lineHeight: 1.5)),
      Text(child: formatMoney(options.product.display_price_cents), size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold, color: Color.primary)
    ])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "product", type: Product, required: true)],
)
